source.title: Editor-based Menu, Campaign Scripting and Billboard Manipulation

engine: Java 17 modern PSX-style title; physical PS1 limitations only optional emulation profiles

requirements.text: Shallow navigable menu graph with focus, action, back-route and dependency validation
15-block virtual memory card, save-slot icon/title manager and cancelable boot animation
Instant controller/dpad selection, legible pixel-style and monospace text, inclusive mouse/keyboard navigation
No mandatory 15-block saves, intentional format delays, fixed 3-menu depth or disabling smooth scrolling/accessibility
Idempotent lifecycle commands and typed state transitions, disallow duplicate START
On actual STOP release session-owned resources without erasing persisted player progress
Bounded event/trigger execution; no untrusted Java, busy loops, unsafe recursion
Explicit dependency registry and warning on referenced asset/menu/script deletion
Visual graph with separate mock authoring state from authoritative host gameplay

modules.status: portable authoring controller planned; live game binding not yet implemented

owners: Existing game SceneRenderer, asset pipeline and lighting module

requirements.text: Original vs mapped 3D preview using actual game renderer, not mock-only preview
Aspect preset 256x256 / 512x256 without destructive original resize, optional CLUT/palette/dither profile
Debounced lightweight preview with explicit commit/bake, undo and atomic rollback
Per-layer texture byte/VRAM estimate and measured memory separated
Modern renderer not bound by exact PS1 VRAM, uncompressed texture prohibition or mandatory bilinear shutoff

tests: Start twice has exactly one transition
Stop twice does not repeat cleanup
Invalid state change leaves authored data intact
Delete referenced asset reports concrete dependents
Source billboard hash remains unchanged after preview/bake
Failed bake does not replace last known good output
releasePolicy: Only objective broken launch/build/essential gameplay/network should block release; visuals and historic budget warnings are diagnostic
